                      Most people keep one. Turn this on if your money lives in more than one place.

                            Your data

                            Your planner saves on this device first, in the browser’s own storage. A browser can clear that storage — Safari does it after about a week of not opening the planner — so a backup file is the copy that survives. If you turn on device sync, an encrypted copy is also kept so your connected devices stay up to date.

                            This copy is open in Safari. Safari deletes a website’s saved numbers after about a week of not opening it. Adding the planner to your Home Screen (or Dock on a Mac) stops that.

                            Your first backup has not been downloaded yet.

                            Erasing takes every number off this device and stops syncing here. It does not erase your other connected devices. No undo — download a backup first.

                                                    Pick a screen. Read only that.

                                                    Every screen of the planner gets its own colour below. Each card is one thing you will see there, and what to do with it. The same words are behind the little question marks inside the app, so you can read them here or there.

                                                        How much actually went out?

                                                        the planned figure is filled in; change it if the real bill was different

                                                        This only changes what comes off your balance for this one payment. The bill itself, and the share put aside each month, stay exactly as they are. Typed it wrong later? Untick the bill and tick it again. Not sure? Close this and the bill stays unpaid.

                                                        Was this already out?

                                                        Yes is right when the bank showed that balance after the bill had gone. Not sure? Close this and the bill stays unpaid. Nothing changes, and the number reads lower rather than higher.
